name: talent-removal-with-legacy-gated-entry
contract: Characters that bought a gated CharacterAdvancement entry before the tab-investment gates were
enforced keep that entry with too little invested below it. Every talent change uploads the whole
build, so the old entry must not block other changes: a gated entry that was already short and
does not rise in rank passes the gate. The Reaper learns entry 5495 (spell 572340, TabAEInvestment 9)
with nothing invested, as an old build had it. Buying entry 6708 (spell 706790) and removing it
again with a right click (paying the usual unlearn price) both work, and 5495 stays known.

steps.label: The old build has the gated entry with nothing invested below it
Buying another talent is not blocked by the old gated entry
The old gated entry stays known
